runners_data.name: Petty Cash
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse facing 46 days off returning to a likely sustained gallop, though Henry Daly's 1/9 recent record raises trainer form concerns

runners_data.name: Maximum Offers
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong recent chase form including a 35-length course-and-distance victory last month, well-suited to tracking the likely moderate early pace
runners_data.comment: Beat the only other finisher by a wide margin over C&D last time; up just 2lb; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Beat the only other finisher by 35l over C&D (good) last month on third chase attempt and second start in cheekpieces; open to further progress in this sphere and warrants respect up just 2lb.

runners_data.name: Mahler Moon
runners_data.note: Prominent style perfectly matches the race shape with excellent good ground form this spring, though Fergal O'Brien's modest 5/27 strike rate is a slight negative
runners_data.comment: In great form on good ground this spring and may well remain competitive
runners_data.spotlight: In great form on good ground this spring, winning twice and running well in between; raised only a further 2lb for Wincanton performance (3m1f) last time; likely to remain competitive.

runners_data.name: Smurfette
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare needing the pace to collapse from her back-of-field position, though her 3-11 chase record shows reliable finishing ability when getting the right race shape
runners_data.comment: Consistent mare who ran creditably last time when bidding for Southwell double; solid
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent mare who is 3-11 over fences; ran creditably (close second) last time when bidding for a Southwell double (3m/3m2f); up another 3lb but again looks a solid contender.

runners_data.name: The Gypsy Davey
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with perfect 3-3 Hereford record who can exploit amateur rider's 7-pound allowance, though 39 days off and trainer's 0/5 recent form adds risk
runners_data.comment: 3-3 at Hereford (2m/2m5f); new trip is the question mark
runners_data.spotlight: Achieved nothing on return from layoff last time but may well prove resurgent returned to Hereford with the outing under his belt, being 3-3 here (2m/2m5f); new trip is the question mark.

runners_data.name: Edgewell
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent 2-2 course-and-distance record on good ground, but trainer Nick Scholfield's 0/9 recent strike rate and need for strong pace are concerns
runners_data.comment: 2-2 over C&D, namely wins this spring; yet to score above Class 5
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 3-13 over fences; 2-2 over C&D, namely good-ground wins this spring; below par at Fontwell in hat-trick attempt but has possibilities back here; admittedly yet to score above Class 5.

races.paceDynamic: The Gypsy Davey will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a measured gallop over this stamina-sapping 3m1f trip. Maximum Offers and Mahler Moon can track him in the prominent positions, while the hold-up trio of Petty Cash, Smurfette and Edgewell will need to rely on the pace collapsing in the closing stages. With limited early speed in this small field and The Gypsy Davey unlikely to burn himself out, the prominent racers who can stay in touch and kick when the pace lifts will hold the tactical advantage over those coming from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop holds
scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey maintains a solid tempo and the prominent horses stay competitive throughout
scenarios.body: The measured pace never truly collapses, favoring those who stayed handy rather than dropping themselves out. Maximum Offers and Mahler Moon benefit from their prominent positions while the hold-up horses find too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey's perfect Hereford record (3-3) translates to another bold front-running display
scenarios.body: His course form proves decisive as he controls the tempo from the front and finds enough in reserve when challenged. The amateur jockey's 7-pound claim becomes crucial in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late surge from behind
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes truly testing and the leaders weaken significantly in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses finally get their ideal scenario as the pace collapses dramatically. Smurfette's consistency and Petty Cash's class tell when the race falls apart up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Course specialists dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hereford's unique demands favor those with proven track form over current ratings
scenarios.body: The course-and-distance winners Edgewell (2-2 here) and The Gypsy Davey (3-3 here) exploit their local knowledge. Their familiarity with the track's challenges outweighs recent form concerns.

watchPoints.text: The Gypsy Davey's jumping under amateur jockey Stone - any early mistakes could eliminate the main pace angle and transform the race shape
Maximum Offers settling in the early stages given his prominent style - if he races too keenly behind the leader it could compromise his finishing kick
Mahler Moon's position turning for home - his recent good form makes him dangerous if staying prominent, but fatal if dropping too far back
The overall tempo through halfway - this will determine whether hold-up horses Smurfette and Petty Cash have any realistic chance of getting competitive
Edgewell's jumping rhythm early on - his course form is excellent but recent Fontwell disappointment suggests confidence may be fragile

runners_data.name: Haderach

runners_data.name: Noble Don

runners_data.name: Machete Beach

runners_data.name: Backer Bilk

runners_data.name: Delta Legend
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making hurdles debut after long absence, hard to assess without recent evidence

runners_data.name: The Craftymaster
runners_data.note: Hold-up style hurdles debutant with strong AW form, benefits from ideal tactical setup despite turf concerns
runners_data.comment: Nine AW wins; turf record leaves him with something to prove on hurdles debut
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles debutant who is a nine-time AW winner at 1m6f/2m, most recently in March; one of the better contenders in terms of achievements but an unconvincing turf record leaves him with something to prove.

runners_data.name: Alex The Great
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with fade-in-finish warning and modest form, likely outclassed despite tactical advantage
runners_data.comment: AW Flat winner; beaten long way over C&D switched to hurdles last time
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time AW winner at a modest level on Flat; beaten long way over C&D switched to hurdles time; opposed.

runners_data.name: Whatcombe
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tactical advantage as only pace angle but fade warning suggests vulnerable late

races.paceDynamic: Whatcombe is the only confirmed front runner in this small field, giving him tactical control from the start. With seven hold-up horses behind him, including The Craftymaster and Machete Beach who will need room to maneuver, the early pace should be sustainable rather than searching. The lack of pace pressure means Whatcombe can dictate terms through the early stages, but his fade-in-finish warning suggests the race will come alive late as the hold-up brigade launches their challenge. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on a pace collapse and finish fastest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Whatcombe sets modest fractions and fades turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get ideal conditions as the race becomes a sprint from the final hurdle. Class acts like The Craftymaster and Machete Beach can unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Don joins Whatcombe early to create genuine pace
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on tired leaders while hold-up horses face a stiffer test. This tempo exposes some of the lesser lights at the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Whatcombe gets easy fractions and finds extra reserves late
scenarios.body: Despite his fade warning, the lack of early pressure allows him to conserve energy for a genuine staying effort. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses refuse to commit early creating a stop-start gallop
scenarios.body: The inconsistent pace suits nothing and the race becomes a lottery in the straight. Long absent horses struggle to cope with the tactical nature.

watchPoints.text: Whatcombe's jumping under pressure - any mistake late could hand race to closers
The Craftymaster's turf handling on hurdles debut after dominant AW form
Traffic problems developing for hold-up horses if Whatcombe sets slow pace
Noble Don's willingness to race prominently early given his mixed running style
Machete Beach's fitness after 359-day absence despite strong yard booking Sheehan

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Earth King
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to form with recent Uttoxeter win, excellent stamina credentials for this trip, Jack Tudor's 5lb claim valuable
runners_data.comment: Back on latest winning mark and recent comeback in a higher class was encouraging.
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time winner over hurdles who had looked to be in the grip of the handicapper since wining at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) in July; however, he's now back on that winning mark and his latest fourth of four at Taunton (3m, good) in a Class 3 was encouraging; respected.

runners_data.name: I Spy A Diva
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely pace scenario, but 124-day layoff raises fitness concerns despite solid record at this distance
runners_data.comment: Largely respectable efforts last season and arguably weighted to win if ready to go.
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins over hurdles (at up to 3m) in 2022 and 2023; missed all of 2024; although yet to match that original level since returning from an absence in October, they have been largely respectable efforts and she's arguably weighted to win, if ready to go after a 124-day break.

runners_data.name: The Long Walk
runners_data.note: Solid recent course form when second here last month, prominent style fits but trainer's poor 14-day record (0/19) is concerning
runners_data.comment: Mixed form this season but enters calculations based on his second over C&D last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Mixed form last season; peak efforts included third at Market Rasen (2m2f) on Boxing Day and most recently when runner-up over C&D last month, beaten 6.5l off this mark; not guaranteed to back that up but in the mix if doing so.

runners_data.name: Queens Venture
runners_data.note: Lone pace-setter can control race after 150-day break, proven at this level but extended absence questions fitness

runners_data.name: Musique De Fee
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage against uncontested leader, recent form patchy despite trainer in excellent form

runners_data.name: Double Click
runners_data.note: Won last time out and hold-up style needs strong early pace, Isabelle Ryder's 5lb claim helps but headgear change to blinkers noted

runners_data.name: Chavez
runners_data.note: Hold-up style least suited to likely race shape, poor recent form and 67-day break suggest he needs this run

races.paceDynamic: Queens Venture stands alone as the only dedicated front runner in this field, meaning she can dictate terms without early pressure over this stamina-sapping 3m1½f trip. The prominent runners (Earth King, I Spy A Diva, The Long Walk) will need to track her sustainable gallop, while the hold-up contingent (Musique De Fee, Double Click, Chavez) face the challenge of making up ground in the closing stages. With Queens Venture able to control the tempo unchallenged, this race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can stay in touch and have the stamina to sustain their effort.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Queens Venture jumps cleanly and sets her own fractions without harassment
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear turning for home, making it very difficult for the hold-up horses to reel her in. The 150-day absence becomes less of a concern when she's not facing early pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit in Queens Venture's slipstream and outstay her
scenarios.body: Earth King or I Spy A Diva can bide their time behind the leader before challenging in the final half-mile when stamina becomes crucial. Their proven staying ability gives them the edge over the genuine front runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and the early leaders weaken significantly
scenarios.body: Musique De Fee or Double Click can use their hold-up style to devastating effect, sweeping past tired leaders. The strong pace would set up perfectly for their finishing kicks over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Queens Venture goes too slowly and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where jockeyship and immediate pace matter more than pure staying power. This scenario least likely given the distance but would favour the most alert prominent runners.

watchPoints.text: Queens Venture's jumping early - any mistakes will disrupt her rhythm and gift the race to the prominent trackers
Earth King's settling behind Queens Venture - if Jack Tudor gets too keen early, stamina reserves will be compromised
Double Click's position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance to utilise finishing kick
I Spy A Diva's fitness levels after 124-day break - watch for any signs of rustiness over this demanding trip
The Long Walk's jumping rhythm - needs to travel smoothly to capitalise on recent course experience

races.name: Wye Valley Metals Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Donnie Azoff
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with headgear on returning from a long break, but may find himself too far back if American Sniper sets a steady pace.

runners_data.name: Pike Road
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good current form who should get a perfect tracking position behind the likely leader American Sniper.

runners_data.name: Mount Anglesby
runners_data.note: Recent winner who races prominently and has the tactical speed to position well, though carrying a 4lb penalty from his last success.
runners_data.comment: Failed to match the level of March's Warwick win latest, but likely to be in the mix.
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of two of his six starts for this stable, most recently at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft) in March off 4lb lower, but didn't quite match that level when fourth (2m4f, good) at Plumpton last month; may need to find more but likely to be in the mix.

runners_data.name: American Sniper
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will dictate terms but trainer David Pipe's poor recent strike-rate is concerning despite the tactical advantage.

runners_data.name: Cluain Chormaic
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who's been running well recently and should get an ideal position tracking the early pace in this tactical affair.

runners_data.name: Oakley
runners_data.note: Prominent type whose course and distance win in November gives him claims, but amateur rider may struggle in a tactical finish.
runners_data.comment: C&D winner in November but hasn't matched that level since and remains on a stiff mark.
runners_data.spotlight: Ended a losing sequence over C&D in November; below that level in three runs since, although recent return at Stratford was a little more encouraging; more needed off his current mark but he has place claims.

runners_data.name: Individualiste
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with headgear who needs the pace to be strong early to bring his finishing kick into play.

races.paceDynamic: American Sniper will lead from the gate with no clear pace pressure in this small field, setting what should be a controlled gallop over this extended trip. Pike Road, Mount Anglesby, Cluain Chormaic and Oakley will track in behind but none are natural pace forcers, meaning American Sniper can dictate terms. The lack of early speed creates a tactical race where positioning becomes crucial in the home straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and have something left to pounce, rather than hold-up horses who may find themselves too far back when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If American Sniper maintains a steady rhythm without serious challenges until the home turn
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and those closest behind can strike when ready, with stamina reserves intact for the finish. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground from too far back in a race run at American Sniper's tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Take Over
scenarios.trigger: If Pike Road, Mount Anglesby or Cluain Chormaic pressure American Sniper from the home turn onwards
scenarios.body: The pace lifts just enough to find out American Sniper's stamina reserves while the prominent runners have tracked the pace perfectly to strike. Those who've stalked the leader are best positioned to capitalize when the race develops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly sedate and the race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: Donnie Azoff and Individualiste benefit from a truly-run race that allows them to use their finishing kicks. The race becomes more about who has the most left in the tank rather than tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: American Sniper Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If American Sniper gets completely uncontested fractions and nobody can match his sustained effort
scenarios.body: The leader's class tells when given such an easy time, and he finds enough to hold off all challengers despite the field having every chance to track him. His recent form suggests he's capable when things fall right.

watchPoints.text: American Sniper's early position - if he doesn't go forward immediately, the race loses its likely pace anchor
Pike Road and Mount Anglesby tracking positions - whoever sits closest to American Sniper gains the key tactical advantage
Donnie Azoff's jumping rhythm early - needs to be fluent to stay in contention from his likely hold-up position
The pace through the middle section - if it becomes pedestrian, it plays into the hands of the hold-up horses
Cluain Chormaic's position turning in - has been finishing well recently and needs to be handy enough to use that kick

races.name: Green Dragon Hotel Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Southey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent recent form who should be on the pace throughout, trainer has poor 14-day record but jockey Ben Godfrey knows the horse

runners_data.name: American Empire
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid hurdles form and strong trainer/jockey combination, needs pace to aim at but has winning experience
runners_data.comment: Returned from a break following a wind op with a solid third over C&D last month; player.
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner who made the frame in his first two runs over hurdles before a disappointing effort at Fakenham (2m, good to soft) in October, after which he underwent wind surgery; returned from a break to finish a solid third over C&D last month and, still unexposed, may have more to offer now switching to handicaps.

runners_data.name: Tao Enki
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse whose trainer is in excellent form (2/7) but hasn't won over hurdles and may struggle if pace is moderate

runners_data.name: Not So Sobers
runners_data.note: Long absence of 179 days could work either way, needs strong pace to suit hold-up style and has headgear changes to sharpen him up

runners_data.name: Ettore
runners_data.note: Nicky Henderson four-year-old with Nico de Boinville aboard will look to make most of the running and use his prominent racing style

runners_data.name: Triple Haych
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner who fades in the finish, significant weight advantage but poor recent form makes him hard to recommend

races.paceDynamic: Ettore will take them along from the front with his prominent style, likely joined by Southey who also races prominently. With only 6 runners and no genuine tearaway leader, this should develop into a steady gallop rather than a searching pace. The four hold-up horses (American Empire, Tao Enki, Not So Sobers, Triple Haych) will be tracking behind looking to pounce. This moderate tempo and small field size strongly favours the front-runners and prominent racers who can control proceedings and have less ground to make up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners control
scenarios.trigger: If Ettore and Southey dictate a manageable pace without pressure
scenarios.body: The leaders maintain their advantage as the hold-up horses struggle to close the gap in a steadily-run race. Prominent racers benefit from track position and energy conservation.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely searching despite the lack of speed
scenarios.body: The prominent horses tie up late allowing the closers to sweep past with their superior finishing kicks. American Empire's class and Tao Enki's trainer form shine through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical battle unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys play cat-and-mouse creating an sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of acceleration rather than stamina as multiple horses hit the front in the final furlong. Ettore's Nicky Henderson training and de Boinville partnership proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider strikes late
scenarios.trigger: If Triple Haych overcomes his fading tendency or Not So Sobers finds improvement
scenarios.body: A bigger-priced horse benefits from the pace scenario playing perfectly into their hands despite recent poor form. The long absence works in Not So Sobers' favour as he returns refreshed.

watchPoints.text: Triple Haych's tendency to fade in finishes combined with poor recent form makes him a liability despite the weight concession
American Empire needs the pace to develop properly to unleash his finishing kick from his hold-up position
Ettore's partnership with champion jockey Nico de Boinville could prove crucial in a tactical finish
Not So Sobers returning after 179 days absence may need the run despite his decent handicap mark
Tao Enki's trainer Alastair Ralph hitting 2/7 runners in the last 14 days suggests the yard is in good form

runners_data.name: Kally Des Bruyeres

runners_data.name: Fox Wallace

runners_data.name: O'Grady's Hill
runners_data.note: Another front-runner with blinkers on, consistent placer but 35 career starts without a win raises questions

runners_data.name: Daany
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with class edge but 9-year-old returning from break, needs to avoid getting caught wide

runners_data.name: Kill The Groove
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making underwhelming fence debut after moderate hurdle form, hard to fancy
runners_data.comment: 0-7 over hurdles, though placed, but her recent chase debut was underwhelming.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles though reaching the frame on three starts at Plumpton this year, all over 2m; made an underwhelming switch to fences last month at Fontwell (2m3f, good to soft) trailing in last of the five finishers; needs to raise her game.

runners_data.name: Prairie Queen
runners_data.note: Front-runner who typically does too much early, 20 starts without winning despite regular placing
runners_data.comment: Best to forgive latest effort; on a fair mark and could figure reverting to fences.
runners_data.spotlight: Still winless after 20 starts but placed over hurdles and fences at up to 2m4f (all on a sound surface); did too much too soon when failing to see it out at Exeter (2m, good) last time but had been running consistently well beforehand from this sort of mark and could have a part to play back over fences.

runners_data.name: Danny's Friend
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from long 146-day absence but Christian Williams stable in good form

runners_data.name: Mi Sueno
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tendency to fade in finish, switch to fences adds uncertainty despite recent Taunton second
runners_data.comment: Well treated but needs to build on a return to form last time; now switched to fences.
runners_data.spotlight: Dual soft-ground hurdle winner (handles good) in early 2024 but had been badly out of sorts prior to his second at Taunton (2m, good) last month; now switches to fences and needs to build on that revival, though he remains attractively treated on old form.

races.paceDynamic: Fox Wallace, Prairie Queen, and O'Grady's Hill will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three natural front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. The pace will be genuinely testing over this 2m trip, particularly with Prairie Queen's tendency to do too much too soon creating additional pressure. Four horses wanting prominent positions (Away For The Night, Daany, Kill The Groove, Mi Sueno) will create congestion and potential traffic problems approaching the business end. This strong pace and likely frantic finish clearly favours the hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and benefit from the fierce gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and the prominent brigade gets caught in traffic
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for Kally Des Bruyeres and Danny's Friend to come with late runs. Both have the class and tactical advantage to capitalize when others have done too much work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker wins
scenarios.trigger: If Away For The Night or Daany can secure ideal positions just behind the leaders without getting caught wide
scenarios.body: They'll have the perfect trip to strike approaching the final fence with enough left in the tank. Away For The Night's recent form and Daany's class make them the most likely beneficiaries of this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders can dictate fractions and kick clear before the others respond
scenarios.body: Prairie Queen or O'Grady's Hill could steal it if they manage the pace better than usual. Their combined 26 starts without a win between them makes this unlikely but both have been placed regularly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go steady early and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Mi Sueno or Kill The Groove could benefit from a muddling pace that plays to stamina over speed. However, with three confirmed front-runners this scenario requires them all to show uncharacteristic restraint.

watchPoints.text: Fox Wallace and Prairie Queen could set suicidal fractions if both try to dominate from the start
Away For The Night may get squeezed for room with four horses wanting prominent positions behind the leaders
Danny's Friend faces fitness concerns after 146 days off despite his hold-up style suiting the race shape
Kally Des Bruyeres with tongue-tie could find significant improvement in this tactical scenario
Mi Sueno's stamina limitations may be exposed if the strong pace continues to the finish
